value.deck: GitHub Copilot's usage report now shows token consumption broken down by AI model, enabling organizations to understand and optimize their Copilot usage costs.
shortVersion: Here is the simple version: GitHub Copilot's usage report now shows token consumption broken down by AI model, enabling organizations to understand and optimize their Copilot usage costs.
Visibility into per-model token usage helps platform teams make informed decisions about which models to enable and manage cost allocations for AI-powered development tooling.
